binaries.name: git
binaries.exception: GPL-2.0-only, accepted: git is a separate program of the Worker image that the agent runs as a command; it is built unmodified from the pinned upstream release, linked into none of our code, and the image is never handed to a third party (code-review.com is a hosted service). The complete source is the pinned tarball.
